Probability that a true signal event enters the selected detector sample. Weak acceptance increases reliance on simulation.
A decision to use one identified product despite specified failed or unresolved criteria. It does not change those criteria's grades.
A band groups variations of an uncertainty source. A universe is one variation. A throw is one random draw of the declared uncertain ingredients.
Bias is the average displacement from truth over repeated experiments. A residual is an individual estimate minus its reference. A data-method difference alone does not measure bias.
Resampling to estimate sampling variation. In the Poisson version, each event receives an independent random multiplicity with mean one, and the analysis is repeated.
Successive small decision trees combine into a predictor. GBDT means gradient-boosted decision trees. HGB is the histogram-based implementation used for the paired comparator.
A classifier whose probability output is checked against class frequencies. Density-ratio use also requires the appropriate class-weight normalization.
A test or interval whose long-run behavior has been checked under specified simulated assumptions. This differs from calibrating a classifier probability.
The reported fitted value or distribution. An estimator is the full algorithm and settings that map observations to that output.
CC produces a charged lepton. Inclusive here allows any hadronic final state consistent with the signal definition.
A discrepancy measure, often a covariance-weighted squared distance. Its numerical value needs a specified sampling model before it becomes a p-value.
A classifier separates labeled examples. A regressor predicts a continuous numerical quantity, here including weights for missed events.
Some simulated corrections can be negative. Clipping replaces specified negative weights by a boundary value. Signed-background methods instead represent subtraction through negative contributions.
Closure unfolds simulated data with known truth. Pseudo-data are the simulated observations. A toy is one simulated repeated experiment.
A conclusion that holds under the specified model, detector and sampling assumptions. Agreement in arithmetic does not establish all of those assumptions.
Covariance records variances and correlations between bins. Its trace sums the bin variances. The width of a linear projection with coefficients u is sqrt(u^T C u).
Fraction of repeated intervals containing the specified truth. Below the stated confidence level is undercoverage, above it is overcoverage. Aggregate coverage can hide poor regions.
CV is central value. Nominal denotes the reference settings. A tune modifies simulation using fitted or chosen adjustments. The unfolding prior is its starting truth distribution.
A factor that changes the relative population of events at given coordinates. An event weight scales that event's contribution to the estimated distribution.
A rejection decision resolved despite the Monte Carlo uncertainty in the estimated tail probability, using the declared confidence-interval rule.
Integrate over an added coordinate to recover a lower-dimensional distribution. Normalization agreement is weaker than agreement in every cell.
Eavail / recoil / ECAL / blob / muon fuzz

Eavail is the implemented visible-hadronic-energy quantity, detailed in B1. Recoil is non-muon activity. ECAL is the electromagnetic calorimeter. Blobs are reconstructed aggregates of deposits. Muon fuzz is nearby muon-associated energy subtracted from recoil.
An ensemble is a collection of repeated fits. A replica or member is one fit. A seed fixes a pseudo-random sequence. Seed variation and event-resampling variation probe different effects.

Alpha is the allowed false-rejection probability. Familywise control bounds the probability of any false rejection across the declared set. Holm applies successively adjusted thresholds to ordered p-values.

Fiducial volume is the selected detector region. Phase space here means the allowed kinematic domain. The project's FPS work extends truth-muon cuts while retaining the tracker-volume and reconstructed-selection requirements.

The tested truth has generator G's rates in fine cells and MnvTune shapes, with G's finite-MC fluctuations, below them. Sub-grid denotes structure within those cells. This is a specified hybrid model, not arbitrary generator truth.
Flux / protons on target, POT / FHC
Flux is incident neutrinos per area. POT measures accelerator exposure. FHC means forward horn current, the beam-focusing configuration used for neutrino mode.
A functional is a declared extracted quantity, such as a bin or projection. A supported cell has simulation support under the analysis's declared domain rules.
Gaussian is the normal distribution. SD measures spread around the mean. RMS is the square root of the average squared quantity. A tail probability is not automatically a Gaussian significance.
A generator simulates interactions and final-state particles using a physics model. Monte Carlo uses random sampling. GENIE, NuWro and GiBUU are generator frameworks used here.
The distribution of reconstructed signals given an underlying event. Hadronic response concerns energy and activity from the non-leptonic part of the event.

A hash or digest identifies file bytes. A checkout is a local code version. An import path controls where the program finds modules. Correct file hashes alone do not prove the intended modules executed.
Simulation samples reserved for distinct stages of evaluation. A fixed bank is a finite parent sample, so inference using it remains conditional on that bank.
An iteration repeats OmniFold's two steps. Capacity describes how complex a fitted function can be. Restricting either can stabilize estimation but retain bias toward the prior.
Kappa scales the last measured change under grid refinement. The reported scan follows that one direction and does not bound the unknown remaining error.

Lateral changes shift event coordinates and can change selection. Vertical changes alter weights. A surrogate approximates a more expensive change, here the specified linear treatment of lateral variations.
Software implementations of the learner. A backend is a selectable implementation. Matching broad tree settings does not make different backends the same estimator.
MAT is the MINERvA Analysis Toolkit. MinosEfficiency is the MINOS selection-efficiency uncertainty band. GEANT-based detector simulation includes hadron-transport variations.
A miss is a true signal event without a selected reconstructed partner. Purity is the predicted signal fraction in a detector bin. Background is selected activity outside the declared signal.
The null is the specified hypothesis tested. A p-value is its tail probability for the observed statistic. Power is the probability of rejecting the null under a specified alternative.
An uncertain model or detector ingredient varied while testing the main physics hypothesis.
PET is the point-cloud transformer used in OmniLearn. A transformer learns interactions among object representations through attention. A token is one object's input representation.
A point cloud is an unordered set of objects. Full-event PET includes muon information alongside recoil objects. The historical recoil-only classifier omitted the muon.
PDG is a particle-identity code. One-hot uses separate category indicators. Pooling combines multiple objects into a summary. Pretraining learns parameters on another sample before this task.
Energy transfer, magnitude of three-momentum transfer, positive spacelike transfer squared, and experimenter's hadronic mass. B2 gives the relations and operational interpretation.

Quasielastic resembles nucleon knockout. Resonances are excited hadronic states. DIS is deep-inelastic scattering at high hadronic mass. 2p2h involves two particles and two holes in the nuclear state. MEC means meson-exchange current, the label used for the Valencia two-nucleon contribution in these predictions.
Here R = 1 - sum|unfolded-target|/sum|prior-target| for unit-normalized histograms. The sum of absolute differences is L1 distance. R becomes unstable when the injected marginal change is tiny.
Movement caused by tiny numerical perturbations of the same inputs. It can matter when statistical intervals are similarly small.
One numerical value per event for a chosen property. Five recorded observables need not represent five independent physical degrees of freedom.
A shape-only comparison removes overall normalization. A total comparison retains rate information as defined by the campaign statistic.
Student-t accounts for estimating a spread from a small sample. Clopper–Pearson gives exact binomial confidence limits for an exceedance probability. Neither fixes model misspecification.
Statistical variation comes from finite event samples. Systematics reflect uncertain detector or physics ingredients. Training variation comes from the learning procedure at fixed inputs.
Sufficient products retain what is needed for a specified calculation. Replay recomputes from them. Regeneration rebuilds upstream simulation or training. RC4 is the local fourth release candidate.

Terminal means a study ended under its rules. A gate is a required check before a next action. VL identifies validation-ledger entries. The s5 labels identify bounded scalar campaigns, not separate measurements.
The claim that a band constructed for one estimator also describes another estimator; here it remains unmeasured.
Energy transferred from the lepton to the hadronic system, distinct from the selected visible-energy sum Eavail.
A truth quantity distinguishable through the observed detector distribution under stated assumptions.
A local information-based precision diagnostic for a specified response model and estimator class; not a universal bound on biased or differently specified estimators.
Probability of at least one false rejection across the stated family of tests.
One hour of use of one NVIDIA A100 GPU; distinct from a CPU core-hour or whole-node hour.
